_doc: Headwaters source registry - Chennai episodic sources. Schema + design notes: docs/specs/headwaters.md (local). Validate: npm run data:check. Baseline/accept: scripts/check-upstream-editions.ts --accept <id>.

sources.notes: NWMP annual River Water Quality data. Serves Chennai (4 rivers/10 stations), Bengaluru (Vrishabhavathi/Arkavathy/Dakshina Pinakini), Madurai (Vaigai 10059/10060). CPCB MIGRATED DOMAIN (verified 2026-07-26): the old cpcb DOT nic DOT in host is dead (DNS resolves to 164.100.58.91, no HTTP on 80 or 443); everything lives on cpcb.gov.in, which serves a valid TLS chain - insecureTLS is NOT needed here and was removed 2026-07-26. The old entry pointed at the dead host, which is why this source never checked successfully and had no lastSeen; the 2026-07-21 baseline recorded it as a CPCB outage, which was the wrong diagnosis. Watch target is /nwmp-data/, which lists one year page per edition (nwmp-data-2012 ... nwmp-data-2025 as of 2026-07-26). A NEW EDITION SHOWS UP AS A NEW nwmp-data-YYYY LINK - that is the signal. /nwmp-data-2/ is a stub last updated 20 Nov 2018 and /wqm/ has no directory listing, so neither works for link-set. linkPattern matches year pages plus wqm/YYYY/ document paths, and deliberately excludes the site-wide boilerplate PDFs (APPs_CPCB, gst_details, stqc-cert, E-GOVERNANCE, it_technical_activity) that appear on every CPCB page. Annual river data also resolves directly at https://cpcb.gov.in/wqm/{YEAR}/WQuality_River-Data-{YEAR}.pdf (2021-2024 verified, 5-15 MB each). CAUTION on the 2025 edition: the nwmp-data-2025 page exists and links WQuality_River-Data-2025.pdf, but that file is 465 KB / 2 pages of YAMUNA DATA ONLY (created 18 Jun 2026) and contains none of our rivers - grep for Cooum, Adyar, Vaigai, Vrishabhavathi, Mithi returns zero. The full national 2025 edition has not landed. ALWAYS confirm river coverage inside the PDF before treating a new year as actionable; the year page appearing is not sufficient.

lastSeen.edition: year pages through nwmp-data-2025 (2025 river file is Yamuna-only)
